title: Omarchy puts coding agents into the operating-system workflow
friendlyTitle: A Linux desktop built to work closely with AI agents
summary: Omarchy presents an Arch-based Linux environment designed to make agents part of routine system work. It supports a choice of coding agents, agent-assisted crash diagnosis, and skills for changing or extending the desktop through apps, themes, and plugins.
friendlySummary: Omarchy lets people choose an AI coding agent to help explain crashes, change the desktop, and build plugins or themes. The agent is treated as part of the computer setup, not just a separate chat app.
whyItMatters: This moves agent use beyond a separate chat window and into the maintenance of the computer itself. That can make troubleshooting and customization more accessible, but it also makes clear permissions, reviewable changes, and recoverable configuration more important.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It may make Linux easier to fix and personalize, but users should still review changes that affect the whole computer.
